messages:
zoe: uploaded 2 photos — meet Henry, my office axolotl. he hates fluorescent lights but loves pebbles. https://img.redwood.internal/zoe/henry-1.jpg https://img.redwood.internal/zoe/henry-2.jpg

priya: this is the chillest animal i've ever seen. is that a tiny plant? :sunglasses:

aj: axolotl squad forever. does he wave? :wave:

zoe: he does a little wiggle when it's snack time. also the tank has tiny LEDs that look like a disco. :sparkles:

giphy-bot: https://giphy.com/gifs/axolotl-cute-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI

priya: proposing an official office lunch break named after Henry — "Henry Hour" :alarm_clock: whos in?

aj: vote: enamel pin or desktop terrarium? :ballot_box_with_ballot:

zoe: pin wins (i'm biased). thanks for the love — Henry sends a very slow blink and zero judgement about merge conflicts.
